task: Na realitnom portali nastav filtre: typ "2-izbovy byt", lokalita "Bratislava – Staré Mesto", typ ponuky "prenajom", maximalna cena 800 EUR mesacne. Zorad vysledky od najnovsich. Vypis nazov, cenu a m2 prvych 3 vysledkov.

goalSpec.goal: Filter real estate listings on Nehnutelnosti.sk based on specified criteria, sort them by newest, and extract the name, price, and square meters of the first 3 results.
successCriteria: The cookie consent overlay is no longer visible.
The search results page is displayed with the correct filters applied for type '2-izbovy byt', locality 'Bratislava – Staré Mesto', offer type 'prenajom', and maximum price 800 EUR.
The name, price, and m2 of the first 3 listings are extracted and provided in the final answer.
goalSpec.stopCondition: The requested information for the first 3 listings is extracted and the results are sorted.
assumptions: The website interface remains consistent during the interaction.
The sorting option 'Najnovšie' (Newest) will be available on the results page after applying filters.
constraints: Only interact with the provided web page and its elements.

subtasks.title: Accept all cookies to dismiss the overlay.
subtasks.doneWhen: The cookie consent overlay is no longer visible.

subtasks.title: Set the property type to '2-izbovy byt', location to 'Bratislava – Staré Mesto', and offer type to 'prenajom'.
subtasks.doneWhen: The 'Vyberte typ nehnuteľnosti' field is set to '2-izbovy byt', the 'Vyberte mesto, obec, okres...' field is set to 'Bratislava – Staré Mesto', and the 'Vyberte typ' field is set to 'prenajom'.

subtasks.title: Click the 'Filter' button to open advanced filters and set the maximum price to 800 EUR.
subtasks.doneWhen: The advanced filter section is open and the maximum price field contains '800'.

subtasks.title: Click the 'Hľadať' (Search) button to apply all selected filters.
subtasks.doneWhen: The search results page is loaded, reflecting all applied filters.

subtasks.title: Sort the search results by 'Najnovšie' (Newest).
subtasks.doneWhen: The search results are visibly ordered by the newest listings.

subtasks.title: Extract the name, price, and m2 for the first 3 listings.
subtasks.doneWhen: The name, price, and m2 of the first 3 listings are extracted and reported.
